_verify_warning: BROKER MUST VERIFY: this control list is a reasonable default, NOT the broker's aggregator audit document. Verify against your aggregator's current audit checklist before relying on this.

controls.name: Credit guide and privacy consent signed
controls.broker_action: Confirm the signed credit guide and privacy consent are on file, dated at or before the first credit assistance conversation.

controls.name: CPR / credit proposal completed, signed, dated (<90 days), fees complete
controls.broker_action: Verify the CPR/credit proposal is complete, signed, dated within the last 90 days, and all fee disclosures are filled in.

controls.name: Best Interests Duty evidence (3-lender comparison, lowest-cost rationale, recommended-product reasons, TMD fit)
controls.broker_action: Confirm a documented comparison of at least 3 lenders, a lowest-cost rationale, written reasons for the recommended product, and a target market determination (TMD) fit assessment.

controls.name: Interview details and chronological file notes
controls.broker_action: Confirm interview details are recorded and file notes are chronological and complete.

controls.name: Identity / AML verification
controls.broker_action: Confirm identity has been verified to AML/CTF standard (e.g. VOI process) with certified ID documents on file.

controls.name: Income and employment evidence consistency
controls.broker_action: Cross-check declared income and employment against payslips, tax returns and NOAs; resolve any inconsistencies before submission.

controls.name: Living expense review vs statements
controls.broker_action: Compare declared living expenses against bank statement transaction patterns and note any material variance.

controls.name: Conflicts of interest disclosure
controls.broker_action: Confirm any conflicts of interest (referral relationships, commissions, ownership links) have been disclosed to the client in writing.

controls.name: Credit history explanation where flagged
controls.broker_action: Where the credit report shows defaults or adverse listings, obtain and file the client's written explanation.
